description: Case index for the portable conformance kit (CONFORMANCE-PORTABLE-KIT). Each entry names a case file under cases/<case_id>.json and the stable contract/scenario IDs it exercises.

cases.title: Happy path: one execution, one accepted candidate, work completes
Assurance rejection triggers a fresh execution/candidate; the second candidate is accepted
Execution failure is retried without overwriting attempt history
Retry budget prevents a fourth execution; policy resolves to DEC-BLOCK
A started, unobserved execution is a legal non-terminal resting point; nothing is fabricated
A started, unsettled assurance is a legal non-terminal resting point; nothing is fabricated
A fresh replay under a recorded non-default max_attempts=2 reconstructs BLOCKED, not a wrongly-derived READY
A legacy FX-CREATE-WORK record with no max_attempts field folds under the schema default (3)
A legacy journal with max_attempts recorded but max_assurance_attempts absent folds under budget 1, not the schema default 2
Re-observing the exact same rejected candidate inherits its verdict instead of raising a conflict
Re-observing a candidate with no settled (only abandoned) assurance history rests at a marked, non-erroneous conflict
Abandoning an unresolved candidate-observation conflict with the retry budget exhausted blocks with reason attempt-abandoned
Abandoning an unsettleable assurance with retry budget remaining returns to READY, never fabricating a verdict
Operator cancellation from READY closes the work as terminal CANCELLED, not a verdict
Operator cancellation from EXECUTING clears the in-flight execution marker
Operator cancellation from ASSURING clears the in-flight assurance marker
Cancelling an already-ACCEPTED work is rejected with a canonical conflict, never silently accepted
Assurance evidence naming a fingerprint that does not match the bound candidate is rejected, never silently accepted
A verdict outside {accepted, rejected, inconclusive} is a canonical validation error, never guessed toward acceptance
An inconclusive settlement within budget re-requests assurance of the identical candidate under a new assurance identity
The re-requested second assurance of the same candidate accepts, completing the work
A second inconclusive settlement exhausts the assurance budget and blocks -- execution retry budget untouched
A settled execution with no bound candidate is a legal abandon basis, recovering to READY with budget remaining
A non-array `history` is a transport-level ERR-VALIDATION with no fabricated location, never a crash
